body: Did you miss Platform & DevOps Engineering last week? The group took over Commence in Virginia Beach on Wednesday night for three talks that ran the whole range — from letting AI write the app to standing up your own production Kubernetes — with The AI Collective – Hampton Roads co-sponsoring and helping shape the lineup.

Mark Bennett opened with Letting Claude Take the Wheel: The AI Lab — Turning Ideas into Deployed Apps, Safely, Easily, Quickly. Tiffany Richardson-Harrell followed with How a Non-Technical Builder Uses Vibe Coding to Create Custom Apps — the view from someone shipping real tools without a traditional dev background. Yuriy Shyyan closed at the other end of the spectrum with Your Own Production Kubernetes Infrastructure: Deployment Automation with ClusterAPI.
Thanks to Commence for the space and to The AI Collective – Hampton Roads for teaming up on this one.
